_about: Home Inventory trusted product list. The app checks this BEFORE any outside product list, so whatever is here always wins. Key = the barcode number (12-digit UPC, or 13-digit EAN). Fields: name, brand, size, category (Food, Fresh food, Drinks, Snacks, Frozen, Cleaning, Personal care, Medicine, Paper goods, Pet, Baby, Other), place (where it's usually kept), each (how many are inside, for boxes/packs), unit (what one of them is called), image (a picture path, pictures go in images/barcode/<barcode>.jpg, written as ../images/barcode/<barcode>.jpg).
